meta.source: Flaim Fantasy (ESPN) get_matchups for 2020-2025 (every scoring week); 2026 weeks 1-7 from league-all-teams.json

format.playoffs: 4-team winners bracket, two rounds. Semifinals are always two-week matchups (totals = sum of two weeks). Finals were two-week in 2020-2023 and single-week (week 17) in 2024-2025. Consolation ladders follow the same format. See each game scoringPeriods/twoWeekMatchup.

notes: Franchise continuity is by ESPN team ID slot; owners may have changed.
Scores rounded to 2 decimals. Unknown values are null.
isPlayoff = any postseason tier (winners bracket or consolation). Playoff record counts winners-bracket games only.
Head-to-head series include every game (regular season, winners bracket, and consolation). Each two-week playoff matchup counts as one game.
Points per week (pointsPerWeek) averages every individual weekly score including each leg of two-week playoff matchups.
2026 week 8 is in progress and excluded.
No ties occurred in any game.
meta.displayPolicy: displayName = current sanitized app name (teamIndex in league-all-teams.json). Per-season names reuse history displayName from league-all-teams.json; team 7 in 2026 shows its real ESPN name.
meta.aliasReview: Season display names use clean aliases for vulgar/slur ESPN names: Ni66as in  Trouble -> In Trouble (team 7, 2022), The Fucking Letdowns -> The Letdowns (team 3, 2020), Team Wet Ass Pussy -> Team WAP (team 5, 2020), Brioon Omeglemeally😈 -> Brioon Omeglemeally (team 6, 2023-2025), Kabul Cocknballs -> Kabul FC (team 11, 2021-2026). Team 7 in 2026 keeps its real ESPN name by request. Borderline names left unchanged: Team PSU sucks, Hurts to Suck, Rub My  Chubb, Black  Lives.
